group_members: All V36 pose bones, including both complete arms, fingers, helper bones and weapon bones
group_motion: The V39 common turn plus a 0.24 m forward translation, smoothly introduced and removed at idle endpoints
flow_method: Short cubic position and spherical cubic orientation bridges with endpoint velocities from the existing motion

forward_axis: Global authoring +Y, toward the camera viewing direction; applied after the group turn
